titleEn: Technology Moves Fast, Adoption Takes Time
titleZh: 技术发展快，落地 adoption 慢：温室园艺的启示
summaryZh: 本文通过温室花卉种植行业的案例，指出技术研发速度远超种植者实际采用速度。核心观点：技术能力本身不足以驱动采用，必须具备合理投资回报率且能融入现有生产环境；供应商与种植者需加强沟通，避免为技术而技术。对智慧畜牧行业同样具有借鉴意义——IoT、AI、机器人等技术的落地需兼顾经济性与易用性。
featuredReason: 智慧畜牧行业同样面临技术研发快、养殖户采用慢的困境，本文关于ROI、易用性和供需匹配的讨论对畜牧技术推广具有直接借鉴意义。
contentFull:
By Brian D. Sparks|October 23, 2026 

 

 

 

 One of my colleagues at our parent company, Meister Media Worldwide, covers the outdoor fruit growing industry and recently attended a technology field day featuring precision agriculture, robotics, and artificial intelligence. While the equipment was impressive, his biggest takeaway was that technology development may be advancing at breakneck speed, but growers are not necessarily adopting it at the same pace.

 As one vendor put it, “We have to focus more on the customer because we’re going at such a fast pace that we’re not giving the customers a chance to keep up with us.”

 I’ve noticed a similar dynamic in recent conversations with greenhouse lighting manufacturers. It’s another sector where the rate of innovation does not always mirror practical adoption in floriculture.

 During these discussions, two key themes emerged.

 First, technological capability alone won’t drive adoption. If a system cannot deliver a reasonable return on investment, growers will keep looking. What that ROI window should be is a separate discussion, but the larger point is that impressive technology still has to make financial sense.

 Second, even if the numbers work, the technology has to fit the greenhouse. If it is too complex to operate, integrate, or troubleshoot, the value quickly becomes harder to justify.

 Jeff Mastin, Director of Lighting Science and Products at TotalGrow Lights, put it this way: “There is potential for a combination of AI, advanced sensors, and adaptive lighting to work together in exciting ways to adjust lighting intensities, spectra, and/or directionality automatically and with improving efficiency. But in reality, it’s extremely complicated and would be a huge risk to automate prematurely.”

 Kassim Tremblay, Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing for Sollum Technologies, makes a similar point from a financial perspective.

 “Growers know they need different types of light. Where it does not always work for floriculture is the financials, because of tight margins and access to electricity.”

 The other factor, Tremblay says, is need.

 “The demand has to be there to justify the cost. If a grower is already meeting all the demand he has, why innovate?”

 Why Suppliers and Growers Need to Work Together

 Growers and manufacturers need to meet in the middle, and that requires frequent communication. Whether through on-site visits or conversations at events such as Cultivate, suppliers need to understand how and when growers adopt technology so they can develop systems that fit real production environments. The same applies in the other direction. Growers need to be clear about the problems they are trying to solve and where additional complexity is worthwhile.

 Customization can be valuable, but it can also introduce more variables into operation and troubleshooting. The goal should not be technology for technology’s sake, but tools that growers can realistically use, maintain, and justify financially.

translationZh:
我在母公司Meister Media Worldwide的一位同事负责户外水果种植行业报道，最近参加了一场精准农业、机器人和人工智能的技术田间日活动。虽然设备令人印象深刻，但他最大的收获是：技术开发可能正以惊人的速度推进，但种植者采用技术的速度未必同步。

正如一位供应商所说：“我们必须更加关注客户，因为我们前进的速度太快了，没有给客户跟上我们的机会。”

在最近与温室照明制造商的对话中，我也注意到了类似的动态。这是另一个创新速度并不总是反映花卉种植实际采用情况的领域。

在这些讨论中，出现了两个关键主题。

**第一，仅靠技术能力无法推动采用。** 如果一个系统不能带来合理的投资回报，种植者会继续寻找。投资回报窗口应该是多少是另一个话题，但更大的要点是：令人印象深刻的技术仍然必须在财务上合理。

**第二，即使数字可行，技术也必须适配温室。** 如果操作、集成或故障排除过于复杂，价值很快就会变得难以证明。

TotalGrow Lights照明科学与产品总监Jeff Mastin这样说道：“AI、先进传感器和自适应照明的组合有潜力以令人兴奋的方式协同工作，自动调整光照强度、光谱和/或方向性，并不断提高效率。但在现实中，这极其复杂，过早自动化将是一个巨大的风险。”

Sollum Technologies销售与营销高级副总裁Kassim Tremblay从财务角度提出了类似观点。

“种植者知道他们需要不同类型的光。在花卉种植中并不总是奏效的地方在于财务，因为利润空间紧张且电力获取受限。”

Tremblay说，另一个因素是需要。

“需求必须存在才能证明成本的合理性。如果种植者已经满足了他所有的需求，为什么要创新？”

**为什么供应商和种植者需要合作**

种植者和制造商需要在中间相遇，这需要频繁沟通。无论是通过现场访问还是在Cultivate等活动上的对话，供应商需要了解种植者如何以及何时采用技术，以便开发出适合真实生产环境的系统。反过来也一样。种植者需要明确他们试图解决的问题，以及在哪里增加复杂性是值得的。

定制化可能有价值，但也可能给运营和故障排除引入更多变量。目标不应是为技术而技术，而是种植者能够现实地使用、维护并在财务上证明合理的工具。

contentHtml:
Discussions with growers and lighting manufacturers shine a light on the pitfalls of speedy technology adoption.
The post Technology Moves Fast, Adoption Takes Time appeared first on Greenhouse Grower.
